claims.statement: The harbour establishing shot is finished in every corner, with no zone below the detail floor
evidence: npm run audit:scene -- --image artifacts/harbour-night-wide.png --brief design/scene-brief.json --grid 8x5 → verdict=pass-scene-complete

claims.statement: Both dock assets read as their role from 30 studs in night lighting
The lit checkpoint is the highest-contrast point in the frame, so the eye lands where the brief intends
evidence: audit:scene focal zone D5, focal ratio 2.8

checks.observation: Re-captured the wide shot after the last lighting tweak; the hash moved from 91be44 to 4c9a1e, so the earlier screenshots are stale and were discarded
Every claim maps to a gate run from this capture; a fourth claim about water shimmer had no evidence and was deleted
Tried to break the corner claim by re-running with a 10x6 grid, which is stricter than the shipped default; the corners still passed
Assumed the night lighting rig is final. Checked with the lighting file date: it was last edited before the asset pass, so the assumption holds for now
Only the wide shot and two asset shots were captured. The combat camera and the rainy weather state were never rendered
The emissive change could have blown out the water shader; re-captured the water-facing shot and the highlight ratio is unchanged
Removed the phrase "the scene is done" and replaced it with the two shots that actually passed
Rendered both assets as black fills at 64px: the lantern hook and the dock hook crescent stay distinguishable

counterExamples.claim: Every corner of the frame is finished
counterExamples.attemptedFalsification: Re-ran the scene gate at 10x6, a finer grid than the one used to approve it
counterExamples.result: No empty corner appeared, so the claim survives a stricter test

counterExamples.claim: The checkpoint reads as the focal point
counterExamples.attemptedFalsification: Converted the frame to greyscale to remove the warm lantern colour advantage
counterExamples.result: It still leads on value alone, though the margin narrows

counterExamples.attemptedFalsification: Totalled declared triangles against the mobile tier budget rather than the desktop one
counterExamples.result: Failed on the mobile tier at 260k against a 180k budget, so the claim is scoped to desktop only

blindSpots: Combat camera distance was never captured
Rainy weather state exists in the design but was not rendered
Only one procedural seed of the dock layout was reviewed

issuesFound.summary: Mobile tier exceeds the triangle budget by 80k
Upper-right sky zone was one point below the detail floor before a haze layer was added

residualRisk: Approved for the desktop tier only. The mobile budget failure is open, and the rainy state and combat camera are unverified.
whatWouldChangeMyMind: A capture from the combat camera showing the checkpoint losing focal dominance, or a mobile profiling run confirming the frame cost is worse than the declared totals
